title: AMC 8 Practice: Counting Squares on a Grid — Can You Find Them All?
description:
AMC 8 practice problem on counting all the squares on a 4 by 5 dot grid, including tilted ones, solved two ways. (Level 5 of 5)
20 dots, and most kids find 20 squares. But there are more hiding in there! Vantee shows two ways to find every one, including the sneaky tilted squares, then gives you a bigger grid to try yourself.
